Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:1.hebrew: שכן יש לה היתר - לכשתטהר. לפיכך אין יצרו תוקפו, שמובטח הוא לאחר זמן:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:1.english: For it has a permitted time - When she becomes pure. Therefore his inclination does not overpower him, for he is assured [of relations] after a time.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:2.hebrew: שאין לה היתר - אם תמצא טמאה, ולפיכך לבו רודף אחריה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:2.english: For she has no permission - If she is found impure [i.e., guilty], and therefore his heart pursues her.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:3.hebrew: גנובים - כלומר, דבר האסור לו, יצרו רודף אחריו:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:12:3.english: Stolen - That is to say, with a thing that is forbidden to him, his inclination pursues after it.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:14:1.hebrew: ופרכוה - כדאמר: שכן יש לה היתר:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:14:1.english: And they refuted it - As it says: For [a menstruant] has a permitted state [i.e., she becomes permitted after immersion].

Rashi on Sotah 7a:15:1.english: It is the same as the first Tanna - of the baraita:

Rashi on Sotah 7a:15:2.english: But they said - According to Rabbi Yehuda, he does not hold this.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:16:1.english: And they threaten her - That she should confess.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:16:2.hebrew: על עדי נפשות - כדאמרינן בסנהדרין: "הוו יודעין שלא כדיני ממונות דיני נפשות" כו' בפרק אחד דיני ממונות (סנהדרין דף לז.):
Rashi on Sotah 7a:16:2.english: Over witnesses in capital cases - As we say in Sanhedrin: "Know that capital cases are not like monetary cases," etc., in the chapter "Ehad Dinei Mamonot" (Sanhedrin 37a).

Rashi on Sotah 7a:17:1.hebrew: הרבה ילדות עושה - וגורם לנערה ילדה שתבא לידי קלקול. ושמא אמת הדבר, אל תביאי עצמך לידי מיתה מנוולת זו:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:17:1.english: Much youthfulness does - and it causes a young girl to come to corruption. And perhaps the matter is true; do not bring yourself to this disgraceful death.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:17:2.hebrew: שכינים רעים - יודעים לפתות, ומצויין לה תמיד:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:17:2.english: Bad neighbors - They know how to seduce, and they are always found near her.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:18:1.hebrew: שאינה כדאי לשומען - אינה ראויה לה שאומר לפניה דברי הודאות צדיקים הראשונים, אלא כדי שתודה על קלקולה, כדאמרינן לקמן: יהודה הודה ולא בוש:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:18:1.english: That she is not worthy to hear them - It is not fitting for her that [the court] recite before her the words of confession of the earlier righteous people, except so that she will confess her corruption, as we say below: "Judah confessed and was not ashamed."

Rashi on Sotah 7a:19:1.hebrew: שוברת כתובתה - כותבת שובר על כתובתה: "זניתי, והפסדתי כתובתי", ונותנת ביד בעלה שלא תתבענו לאחר זמן. ואינה נהרגת, שלא התרו בה עדים בשעת מעשה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:19:1.english: She breaks her ketubah - She writes a receipt [releasing the claim] on her ketubah — "I committed adultery, and I have forfeited my ketubah" — and gives it into her husband's hand, so that she will not claim it from him at a later time. And she is not put to death, because witnesses did not warn her at the time of the act.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:1.hebrew: לשער מזרח - שער החיצון, שבו נכנסין להר הבית, ומשם לשער נקנור. הוא שער העליון שבחומה שבין עזרת ישראל לעזרת נשים:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:1.english: To the Eastern Gate - The outer gate through which one enters the Temple Mount, and from there to the Nicanor Gate. It is the upper gate in the wall between the Israelites' courtyard and the Women's courtyard.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:2.hebrew: ששם משקין את הסוטות - מפני שלא נתקדש בקדושת עזרה עובי חלל אותו השער, מפני המצורעין שמכניסין ידיהן לבהונות, ליתן מדם האשם על בוהן ידו. ומחוסר כפורים שנכנס לעזרה — בכרת. לפיכך לא קדשו, שיוכל לעמוד בחלל השער. שאם היה כהן מוציא את דם האשם חוץ לעזרה, הרי הוא נפסל ביוצא. לפיכך צריך להכניס ידו לתוך חלל העזרה, וביאת מקצת שרא רחמנא:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:2.english: For there they give the sotot to drink - Because the thickness of the interior of that gate was not sanctified with the sanctity of the Temple courtyard, on account of the lepers, who insert their hands for the thumbs, in order to place some of the blood of the guilt-offering on the thumb of his hand. And one who lacks atonement who enters the courtyard [incurs] karet. Therefore, they did not sanctify it, so that [the leper] could stand in the interior of the gate. For if a priest were to take the blood of the guilt-offering outside the courtyard, it would become disqualified by having gone out. Therefore, he needs to insert his hand into the interior of the courtyard, and the Merciful One permitted entry of [only] part [of the body].

Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:3.hebrew: נקנור - אדם גדול היה, והביא דלתות נחושת מאלכסנדריא של מצרים לאותו שער, ונעשו בו נסים, כדתנן בסדר יומא (דף לז:), ונקראו על שמו:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:3.english: Nicanor - He was a great man, and he brought bronze doors from Alexandria of Egypt to that gate, and miracles were performed with them, as we learned in the order of Yoma (p. 37b), and [the doors] were called by his name.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:4.hebrew: ששם משקין סוטות - דבעינן ״לפני ה׳״, כדיליף לקמן:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:4.english: For there they give sotot to drink - For we require "before the Lord," as [the Gemara] derives below.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:20:5.english: And they purify women who have given birth - Below [the Gemara] explains what this is.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:1.english: Grasps her garments - At her neckline.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:2.english: If [her clothes] were torn - He is not concerned.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:3.hebrew: ואם נפרמו - אינו חושש פרימה גדולה מקריעה, שנקרעה לקרעים הרבה, דמינציי"ר (דימינציי"ר: לחתוך לחתיכות דקות, לקרוע לגזרים) בלע"ז, כמו האי דפרים סילקא (שבת דף עד:):
Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:3.english: And if they come apart - [The priest] is not concerned about an unraveling that is greater than a tear, [meaning a garment] that was torn into many pieces, [which is called] deminuzier in French (deminuzier: to cut into small pieces, to tear to shreds), like that case of one who tears a beet (Shabbat 74b).

Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:4.hebrew: עד שמגלה את לבה - ולקמן יליף לה מקרא:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:4.english: Until he uncovers her heart - And below (in the Gemara) it derives this from a verse.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:5.hebrew: וסותר את שערה - מקליעתו. ולקמן יליף לה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:21:5.english: And he unbinds her hair - From its braid. And below (Sotah 8a), [the Gemara] derives it.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:2:1.hebrew: לא שכיחא - ולא מסקי אינשי אדעתייהו למחשדינהו לטהורות בהכי. והא דשני לעיל לר' שמעון, מדזכות לא תלה — עדים נמי לא תלו, משום דאכתי לא הוה קיימא לן דרשא דהאי קרא:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:2:1.english: It is not common - And people do not think to suspect pure women on this account. And as for what [the Gemara] answered above according to R. Shimon — since he did not make [the matter] depend on merit, [the Gemara answers that] they also did not make [it] depend on witnesses, because we did not yet have the exposition of this verse established for us.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:3:1.hebrew: שמא יבא עליה בדרך - שצריך להשקותה בירושלים בב"ד הגדול, כדלקמן:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:3:1.english: Lest he have relations with her on the way - For [the husband] must give her to drink in Jerusalem, in the Great Court, as [stated] below.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:3:2.english: Is trusted with her - That he will not have relations [with her on the way].

Rashi on Sotah 7a:4:1.english: They only taught - This refers to what we learned in [tractate] Kiddushin: "But a woman may be secluded with two men."

Rashi on Sotah 7a:4:2.hebrew: שמא יצטרך כו' - הכא נמי, הואיל ושניהם אסורין בה, לא סגי בתרי. שמא יצטרך הבעל או שליח ב"ד לנקביו כו':
Rashi on Sotah 7a:4:2.english: Lest he need, etc. - Here too, since both of them are forbidden to her, two [men] are not sufficient, lest the husband or the agent of the court need to relieve himself, etc.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:5:1.hebrew: דליהוי עליה סהדי - אם יבא עליה, יעידו עליו לב"ד הגדול ולא ישקוה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:5:1.english: So that there will be witnesses against her - If he has relations with her [after the warning], they will testify against him before the Great Court, and they will not give her to drink.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:6:1.english: ל"ש - Because a woman may be secluded with two men.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:6:2.hebrew: והוציאוה עשרה - לאשת איש, חוץ לעיר, במטה, בחזקת מתה, לקלקל עמה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:6:2.english: And ten took her out - [They took] a married woman outside the city, on a bier, [made to appear] as though she were dead, in order to commit a transgression with her.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:7:1.hebrew: דידעי לאתרויי ביה - ולומר לו: מן התורה, כשאין האיש מנוקה מעון — שבא עליה משנאסרה עליו — אין המים בודקין את אשתו:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:7:1.english: That they know how to warn him - And to tell him: According to the Torah, when the man is not free of sin — [namely,] that he had relations with her after she became forbidden to him — the water does not test his wife.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:8:1.hebrew: בעלה נאמן עליה - ואין צריך להעמיד עדים אצלו:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:8:1.english: Her husband is trusted regarding her - And there is no need to station witnesses with him.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:8:2.hebrew: סוטה שהיא בלאו - דלא יוכל בעלה הראשון וגו', דאמרינן ביבמות בפ"ק (דף יא:): מה אני מקיים "אחרי אשר הוטמאה"? לרבות סוטה שנסתרה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:8:2.english: A sotah who is [forbidden] by a negative commandment - [As it is written,] "Her first husband… cannot [take her again]…" (Deuteronomy 24:4), as we say in [tractate] Yevamot, in the first chapter (11b): How do I [then] uphold "after she has been defiled"? To include a sotah who was secluded [with another man].

Rashi on Sotah 7a:9:1.hebrew: והיא הנותנת - המדה הזאת שהבאת ראיה לדבריך, היא הנותנת את הדין שאנו אומרים שצריך עדים:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:9:1.english: And it is that which gives - This principle from which you brought proof for your statement is itself what determines the law that we say [the husband] requires witnesses.

Rashi on Sotah 7a:9:2.hebrew: נדה שהיא בכרת - חמורה עליו, ואינו בא עליה:
Rashi on Sotah 7a:9:2.english: A menstruant, which is [punishable by] karet - [Intercourse with her] is severe for him, and he does not come upon her.

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:12:1.hebrew: ואומר מים גנובים - נראה דהאי "ואומר" פירושו הכי, כלומר: מאי תלי בהכי שאין היתר לאיסורה? חדא — דיצרו תוקפו; מאחר שאין היתר לאיסורה, אין מתון בדבר, "אם לא עכשיו אימתי". וא"ת: לא יתקפנו יצרו על אשתו, הואיל ובעלה כבר? "מים גנובים ימתקו":
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:12:1.english: "And it says: 'Stolen waters'" - It appears that this "and it says" means as follows, that is: What relevance does it have that there is no permission for her prohibition? First, his inclination overpowers him; since there is no permission for her prohibition, there is no restraint in the matter — "If not now, when?" And if you say: His inclination should not overpower him with regard to his own wife, since he is already her husband? "Stolen waters are sweet."

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:14:1.hebrew: אמר להו ק"ו ופרכוה - יש לומר: דוקא בפירכא שכן יש היתר לאיסורה פרכוהו, אבל ב"היא הנותנת" לא פרכוהו, ולכך הוצרכה לפירכא אחריתי. דאשכחן בדוכתי סגיאין דחמירא להו לאינשי עבירה קלה, ומסתפו מינה טפי מעבירה חמורה. כגון בפ"ק דכתובות (דף ד:), דחמירא להו אבילות — דלא הוי אלא מדרבנן — מנדה שהיא בכרת; ובפ' הנזקין (גיטין דף נד.), באתריה דרבי יהודה חמירא להו שביעית — דליכא אלא לאו — משבת שהוא בסקילה; ובריש פ"ק דביצה (דף ב:) אמר: האי דקיל צריך הרחקה טפי, דאמר: מ"ש גבי שבת דסתם לן תנא כרבי שמעון, וגבי יום טוב כרבי יהודה? שבת דחמיר — סתם לן כר"ש; י"ט דקיל — סתם לן כרבי יהודה. אלמא: זימנין בדילי מקילתא טפי מחמירתא, וזימנין איפכא. והשתא צריך ליישב הברייתא לפי הירושלמי והתוספתא. דהכי מיתניא בתוספתא (פ"א): ר' יהודה אומר: נאמן עליה בעלה מקל וחומר, ומה נדה שחייב על ביאתה כרת וכו'. ר' יוסי אומר: הכתוב האמינו, שנא': "והביא האיש את אשתו" וגו'. ובירושלמי מיתניא הכי: רבי יהודה אומר: בעלה נאמן וכו'. אמרו לו: לא, אם אמרת בנדה שיש לה היתר וכו'. אמר להם רבי יהודה: גזירת הכתוב הוא, "והביא האיש את אשתו" וגו'. אמרו לו: ובלבד בעדים. והשתא אית לן למימר דבההיא תוספתא פרכוהו, והדר אמר להו קרא, כההיא דירושלמי. אבל מדרבי יוסי איכא לתמוה, דמעיקרא אמר להו קרא, והדר אמר להו קל וחומר:
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:14:1.english: He said to them a kal vachomer, and they refuted it - One can say: Specifically with a refutation [of the type] that there is a permitted [case] for its prohibition, they refuted it; but with [the argument] "she is the one who gives [the drink]" they did not refute it, and therefore it was necessary to [offer] another refutation. For we find in many places that people treat a lesser transgression as more serious and fear it more than a severe transgression. For example, in the first chapter of Ketubot (4b), that they treat mourning, which is only Rabbinic, as more serious than a menstruant, which is punishable by karet; and in the chapter Hanizakin (Gittin 54a), in the place of Rabbi Yehuda they treated the Sabbatical year, for which there is only a prohibition, as more serious than Shabbat, which is punishable by stoning; and at the beginning of the first chapter of Beitzah (2b) it says: This one that is lenient requires more distancing, for it says: What is different that regarding Shabbat the Tanna rules anonymously like Rabbi Shimon, and regarding Yom Tov like Rabbi Yehuda? Shabbat, which is stringent, he rules for us anonymously like Rabbi Shimon; Yom Tov, which is lenient, he rules for us anonymously like Rabbi Yehuda. Evidently: sometimes people distance themselves more from the lenient than from the stringent, and sometimes the reverse. And now it is necessary to reconcile the baraita with the Yerushalmi and the Tosefta. For this is how it is taught in the Tosefta (chapter 1): Rabbi Yehuda says: A woman's husband is believed regarding her by a kal vachomer: If a menstruant, for whose relations one is liable to karet, etc. Rabbi Yose says: Scripture entrusted him [with the matter], as it is stated: "And the man shall bring his wife," etc. And in the Yerushalmi it is taught thus: Rabbi Yehuda says: Her husband is believed, etc. They said to him: No, if you said [this] regarding a menstruant, who has a permitted [case], etc. Rabbi Yehuda said to them: It is a decree of Scripture: "And the man shall bring his wife," etc. They said to him: [Only] provided that it is with witnesses. And now we must say that in that Tosefta they refuted it, and afterward he cited the verse to them, like that [account] in the Yerushalmi. But regarding Rabbi Yose, there is room for astonishment: [for there] initially he cited the verse to them, and afterward he said to them a kal vachomer.

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:1:1.hebrew: יש לה עדים במדינת הים לא שכיחא - וה"ה בא עליה בעלה בדרך, נמי לא שכיח:
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:1:1.english: "She has witnesses in a overseas country" — "This is not common" - And likewise, [the case where] her husband had relations with her on the way is also not common.

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:20:1.hebrew: ששם משקין את הסוטות - בתוספתא (פ"א): שנא' (מלכים א ח׳:ל״א) "את אשר יחטא איש לרעהו ונשא בו אלה להאלותו ובא אלה לפני מזבחך בבית הזה" וכו', "להרשיע רשע" — וצבתה בטנה; "ולהצדיק צדיק [לתת לו כצדקתו שנאמר ואם לא נטמאה האשה וטהורה היא] ונקתה ונזרעה זרע". היא עומדת מבפנים והכהן עומד מבחוץ, שנאמר: "והעמיד הכהן את האשה לפני ה'" — "האשה לפני ה'", ואין כהן לפני ה':
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:20:1.english: For there they would give the sotahs to drink - In the Tosefta (chapter 1): As it is stated (I Kings 8:31): "If a man sins against his neighbor, and he imposes an oath upon him to make him swear, and the oath comes before Your altar in this House," etc., "to condemn the wicked" — [meaning] that her belly swells; "and to vindicate the righteous [to give him according to his righteousness, as it is stated: 'And if the woman was not defiled and is pure'] she shall be cleared and shall bear seed." She stands inside and the priest stands outside, as it is stated: "And the priest shall stand the woman before the Lord" — "the woman before the Lord," but not the priest before the Lord.

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:7:1.hebrew: כי היכי דידעי לאתרויי ביה - והכי אמרינן נמי בפ' אלו הן הגולין (מכות דף ט:) גבי גולין לעיר מקלט: ומוסרין לו שני תלמידי חכמים, שמא יהרגנו בדרך. ודייק בגמרא: מאי, לאו דאתרו ביה? דאי קטיל, בר קטלא הוא! אלמא, גבי התראה בעינן תלמידי חכמים:
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:7:1.english: "So that they will know how to warn him" - And so we also say in the chapter "Elu Hein HaGolin" (Makkot 9b), regarding those who go into exile to a city of refuge: They hand over to him two Torah scholars, lest he [the blood avenger] kill him on the way. And the Gemara infers: What, is it not that they warned him? For if he kills [the exile], he is liable to death! Evidently, regarding warning we require Torah scholars.

Tosafot on Sotah 7a:8:1.hebrew: נדה שהיא בכרת בעלה נאמן עליה - תימה: דמשמע בפרק אין מעמידין (ע"ז דף לו:) דיחוד דעריות דאורייתא, אם כן יחוד דנדה מנלן דשרי? ויש לומר: דוקא יחוד דעריות דאין להן היתר, דומיא דבן עם אמו, אסרה תורה; אבל נדה לא:
Tosafot on Sotah 7a:8:1.english: A niddah, whose [transgression] is punishable by karet, her husband is believed regarding her - This is surprising: for it implies in the chapter "Ein Ma'amidin" (Avodah Zarah 36b) that seclusion with forbidden relatives (yichud of arayot) is prohibited by Torah law. If so, from where do we know that seclusion with a niddah is permitted? And one can answer: Only seclusion with forbidden relatives who have no permitted status, like a son with his mother, did the Torah prohibit; but [seclusion with] a niddah, no.
